mechanism: Prednisolone may increase fluphenazine metabolism via CYP450 induction while both drugs increase CNS depression and psychotropic side effects; prednisolone also increases infection risk and masks psychiatric symptom changes.
action: Monitor for reduced fluphenazine efficacy and increased psychiatric symptoms; watch for opportunistic infections and CNS adverse effects; consider fluphenazine dose adjustment if prednisolone therapy is prolonged.
